source.attribution: All seven suites used --require-clean on the GitHub PR merge commit. Its tree was verified identical to the branch head. The tested commit is retained as the parent of this evidence commit; renderer and fixture code are unchanged.

ci.runner: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04.5 x86_64; not audio device reference hardware

rawReports.policy: Full raw numeric results are committed without rewriting source attribution. The Actions ZIP is an additional copy; its expiration does not remove the committed reports.

coverage: fractional oscillator starts, seek positions and plain/max-route voices
spectral brightness change during a sustained note
Beat Chunk boundaries and repeated Song Beat clips
actual downloaded 16-bit WAV within one LSB, with complete tails

browser: Shipped desktop/mobile cutoff editing, playback, remove/undo and Beat v11/Song v12 import/export; existing modulation, newcomer, rack, layout, microphone, example, Song transport and WAV workflows all pass.
native: Same C++ core executes v3 cutoff curves before per-note modulation. Block-size and allocation assertions remain CI gates. Unsupported effects and legacy motion reject.
limitations: Only one two-point filter.cutoff lane on a piano-roll synth instrument
Onset-based seeking evaluates new notes correctly but does not reconstruct held notes begun before the seek
Scheduled voice plans are immutable; edits apply to new notes or the next pass
Maximum-route Web Audio graph preparation is slow; capture starts after suspended preparation and does not establish interactive startup performance
No audio-device latency, callback deadline, CPU or underrun qualification
No human listening-panel or newcomer comprehension evidence
pre-programmed needs explicit Beat v11/Song v12/execution v3 integration; no silent downgrade
